title: Unit Event — And Now, I Wear This Ribbon — Episode1 All Those Years and Months

meta.Event: And Now, I Wear This Ribbon
meta.Episode: Episode1 — All Those Years and Months
meta.Event Outline: Noticing how Mafuyu feels more at home surrounded by N25 puts a smile on Mizuki's face. Realizing how they're both alike in that sense, Mizuki recalls their former self before joining N25.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Yeah, I should probably have these transitions before the chorus occur at a better tempo...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Alright, if I rearrange these cuts and throw in some wipes, they should look pretty different from before.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Awesome! The first draft of my storyboard's all finished! Looks pretty good, if I do say so myself♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Using Ena's rough draft to put together a storyboard was definitely the right way to go! I should be able to make this video as dynamic as the song like I hoped.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'd like to hear what the others think, but...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (After her mom took away her synthesizer, she had to take a break from arranging music and start focusing more on just writing lyrics...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And she's been logging off so early recently.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (At the same time, Mafuyu stayed with us the entire time when we all went to PXL, so I guess she feels bad about disappointing her mom...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (As worried as I am, I can't really just ask her about...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Voice
rows.Line:
<K, are you there...?
I've finished writing the lyrics, so I'll send them over now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, she's still here. That's good.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh, that was fast.
How did it go?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Heh heh heh. You'll have to see to find out! I just sent it...!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I want to clean it up and make it better, so I'm open to all suggestions!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I like it...
You've brought this song's theme to life while throwing in some nice personal touches, Amia.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Really? Thanks!
I'm glad I put in the effort!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Also, credit where credit's due, the visual imagery in Enanan's rough draft was really amazing and made my job a lot easier...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, can we go with something else for the chorus?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Unfortunately, it'd delay when we upload the song...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But if we're gonna go with this structure, I want the part before the chorus to pack a bigger punch!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <A bigger punch...? Hmm... I thought spins and wipes on one image would work here...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <However, Enanan, you might be right. It might be easier to get K and Yuki's message across by going with your idea. So, what do you two think...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I agree.
Yes, I'd like to upload this song as soon as possible...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But if you two believe that it can be made better, then I'd like for us to make those changes.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Alright, I'll work on my rough draft... What?! It's already half past four?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Also, Yuki, it's been a while since you last stayed on this late...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah, you're right.
Are you sure you don't need to go to bed?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<Yes...
I don't have cram school tomorrow, so I don't need to get up early.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I see.
But please don't push yourself too hard.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <However... I'll have my hands full with cram school starting next week, so I want to do as much as I can right now.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Also, I have another practice exam coming up soon.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Um, Yuki...?
How have things between you and your mom been recently?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<The same as usual...
She's very concerned about my well-being.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <The night of that practice exam, after I told her that I couldn't take it because I wasn't feeling well, she asked that I refrain from staying up so late to study.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Which is why you've been logging off early recently.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<Yes...
I'm only here now because my mom went to bed early.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Outside of that, there's nothing that comes to mind...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But you need to tell us the next time something does happen...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Still, it was really fun to go somewhere and hang out together!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I agree. It even helped me come up with song ideas, so I think it was worth the trip.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. Okay, to be fair, I wasn't sure what was gonna happen after a certain someone showed up looking sick to her stomach... But it turned out to be really fun, so I hope we get to go again.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hehe...
Then, the next time we go, we should pick a day when Yuki isn't...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <The hallway... I thought I just heard a noise...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <She took away your synthesizer already, so if she finds out that you're still doing music-related stuff...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm going to go take a look...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I didn't see anybody...
It may've just been my imagination...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yuki, if you're concerned...
It's okay to reduce the amount of time you spend on here.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Especially since we don't know what's going to happen if your mom finds out... That's on top of studying, so I'd rather not see you forced into a corner.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I feel the most at ease when I'm working here...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu seems to be most at ease whenever she's creating music with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Okay...
But please take a break when you feel the need.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Um...
Isn't that the first time Yuki herself said, “I feel the most at ease when I'm working here”...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<You're right.
Her saying such a thing may be an ominous sign considering what's been going on with her...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But at the same time, I'm kind of glad that she did...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I guess it's now safe to say that we're providing a space where Mafuyu feels comfortable...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, we should probably get back to work soon... Amia, can we have a quick chat about that part before the chorus?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Um... I'll be logging off temporarily to take a break.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay. See you in a bit, K.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Okay, let's run with that!
If you'll take what we just discussed and make those changes to the storyboard...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Sure thing! And you'd be doing me a huge favor if you could start working on the illustrations for the non-chorus parts!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<No problem.
Also, something crossed my mind just now...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <This storyboard... It looks a lot like the first one you did, doesn't it?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <This song sorta had the same theme as that one, so I decided to do a little self-homage! But I didn't think anyone would notice since it was so subtle...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I mean, how long have we known each other now? Lately, I feel like I've been getting a more intuitive sense of what you want to express.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We have known each other for pretty long, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Back then...
I never saw myself being with anyone for very long.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I feel the most at ease when I'm working here...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Uh, no!
It's just... I'm happy to hear that you actually pay close attention to the videos I make, Enanan♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Huh? What's that supposed to mean? I always pay close attention.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<And that makes me really happy!
So, Enanan, thank you!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Okay, okay. You're welcome...
Anyway, let's get back to work.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I must've fallen asleep while talking to Ena yesterday... Argh, my body... I'm aching all over...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What time is it...? Where'd I put my phone...? Oh, Mom sent me a message.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother
rows.Line: <Morning, Mizuki! I'm going to work now! I made some seafood curry for lunch, so please make sure to have some!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Seafood curry?! Sweet!
You're the best, Mom♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother
rows.Line:
<Oh, your sister sent you a package.
I'll leave it down in the living room.>
